label: Pinwheel
depicts: Four pinwheel blades around one small center hub with one straight stick dropping below
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple four blade pinwheel mounted on a straight stick.
avoid_when: Do not use for the denser folded pinwheel when the blade center should look more layered and compact.

label: Pinwheel
depicts: Four folded pinwheel blades around one dense center hub with one straight stick below
use_when: Use when the interface wants a pinwheel whose blades bunch closer into a denser folded center.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler pinwheel when the blade center should stay open and less layered.

label: Playlist
depicts: Three horizontal playlist lines with one circular play button at the lower right
use_when: Use when the interface wants a playlist list view paired with one round play button at the corner.
avoid_when: Do not use for the playlist with the extra right side play panel when the upper right control should look boxed in.

label: Playlist
depicts: Three horizontal playlist lines with one boxed play panel at the upper right and one round play button below
use_when: Use when the interface wants playlist lines paired with a more structured right side play control area.
avoid_when: Do not use for the simpler playlist when the right side should show only one round play button with no boxed panel above.

label: Plugin
depicts: Symmetrical plug block with two short prongs above and one short connector tab below
use_when: Use when the interface wants a centered plug or module block with matching left and right sides.
avoid_when: Do not use for the angled connector piece when the plug head should lean and the cable should enter from one side.
